blocking_rule: Any HOLD_ASSURANCE_COHERENCE disables downstream mutation and stage-transition actions in Center until the coherence defect is resolved.
prohibited: Center must not infer PASS from a partial subset of a gate.
Center must not use stale derived state when a newer graph authority exists.
Center must not interpret an artifact through a newer plan than the plan pinned at artifact creation without an explicit requalification record.
Center must not hide referenced runtime evidence from handoff without an omitted-evidence hash record.
Center must not duplicate engineering acceptance logic; it only checks cross-layer coherence.
